full_track.tags: Chamber pop and baroque pop arrangement featuring a prominent string quartet and harpsichord. The piece is in G major at 124 BPM. The lead violin plays a staccato, rhythmic melody characterized by rapid sixteenth-note runs and trills. A harpsichord provides harmonic support with arpeggiated chords and counter-melodies. The cello and viola maintain a driving, rhythmic pulse using spiccato bowing techniques. The structure alternates between dense contrapuntal sections and more open, melodic passages. The production is clean with a natural room reverb, emphasizing the acoustic textures of the instruments.
